release_notes: AC-CLUB-DISCOVERY-01: Header club dropdown button [+ Khám phá thêm CLB khác] with interactive discovery modal.
AC-CLUB-DISCOVERY-02: Instant search and multi-category filters (Phong Trào, Doanh Nghiệp, Địa Hình Trail, Sinh Viên) + regional filter.
AC-CLUB-DISCOVERY-03: Multi-tier club registration policies: open (⚡ Tham Gia Ngay), approval (📝 Gửi Yêu Cầu), and invite-only (🔑 Nhập Mã Mời).
AC-CLUB-DISCOVERY-04: Reactive UI synchronization across header count badge, switcher list, and activity log club assignment select.
Clean REST API endpoints: GET /api/clubs/discovery, POST /api/clubs/:id/join, POST /api/clubs/:id/leave.
